town_crossing_state — DRIVE town op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.town_crossing_state(world: 'dict', t: 'float', train: 'Optional[dict]', *, exposure: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivetown; drivetown.town_crossing_state(world: 'dict', t: 'float', train: 'Optional[dict]', *, exposure: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("town_crossing_state"))

Usage

Writes the state of the railroad-crossing equipment at time t into the world (all crossings use the same train timetable).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

train = town_run の run["train"](None = 待機: かん上・灯消灯・列車は遠く)。状態は既存 op drivecrossing.crossing_gate_state(警報 → 降下 → 遮断 → 上昇、かんの角)と drivecrossing.crossing_lamp_signal (2 灯の交互点滅、exposure > 0 でカメラの露光平均)で評価する。列車の先頭は t_arrival に道路の縁(手前 margin)に着き、v_train で +y(局所)へ進む。返り値 {"state", "state_name", "boom_angle", "lamps", "entry_forbidden", "train_y"}。

Raises ValueError: world が town_world の物でない、t が非有限、train の鍵が足りない。
